svg.text: 6 PARTY · 22 NPCs · 12 MILITARY · 8 CORRUPTED · 7 BOSSES — ORGANIZED BY GENERATION PRIORITY

g.text: Generate these FIRST — needed for all gameplay footage, screenshots, and vertical slice
Male, young adult village soldier. Athletic build, not bulky.
Practical military clothing with subtle magical accents (glowing trim, Lumina crystal details).
Hair: short-medium, practical for combat. No helmet (face always visible).
• Sword — one-handed, medium length, Lumina-infused glow along edge
• Light armor — leather + metal hybrid, militia-grade, upgradeable visual
• Lumina crystal — small, embedded in gauntlet or belt (magic channel)
Idle · Run · Strafe · Jump · Fall · Land · Dodge · Attack1-3 · JumpAttack · SpellCast · Flinch · Stagger · Death · Interact
Female, young adult. Long blue hair (signature trait — locked per CLAUDE.md).
Mage robes/attire — flowing but practical. Blues and silvers.
Elegant but not fragile. Researcher vibe — she studies Lumina.
• Staff — ornate, Lumina crystal at tip, channels elemental magic
• Mage attire — robes or coat, layered, wind-reactive cloth
• Elemental focus stones — small crystals on staff or belt
Idle · Run · Strafe · Jump · Dodge · SpellCast (Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth) · Flinch · Stagger · Death · CompanionIdle
Start with T-pose base mesh → rig with Mixamo → animate core set (idle/run/attack). These two appear in every screenshot and trailer.
Current placeholder: Red Knight (Amaro) + generic companion (Taighe/"Yuna"). Replace both. Generate together so art style is consistent.
CORE MILITARY ENEMIES — STATE 1 COMBAT LOOP
Needed immediately after party — these populate Greenhollow, Shrine, and Tidewatch
Generic military foot soldier, helmet, uniform
Animations: Idle, Patrol, Chase, Attack(2-hit), Flinch, Death
Heavier armor, tower shield, slower build
Anims: Guard, ShieldBash, SpearThrust, BlockHit, Turn
All share a "military faction" visual language — matching uniforms, insignia, color palette (grey/green/bronze). Generate as a cohesive set. Automaton is the outlier (machine).
Needed for Ironhaven onwards — tougher enemies, new archetypes, elite variants
Small flying machine, rotors, sensor eye
Anims: Hover, Circle, DiveCharge, DiveHit, Recover
Variant needed: Sniper Drone (elite, higher altitude)
Largest human enemy — needs imposing silhouette
Lighter armor, medical pack, runs from player
Visually distinct — medic cross / green accents
Weak: Wind · HP: 60 · Spawns 2 soldiers at 50%
Distinct rank insignia — clearly the "boss" of a group
Same military faction as Batch 2 but escalated. Heavier armor, bigger weapons, more tech. Drone is the first non-humanoid. Elites are recolors/upscales — generate last in batch.
Generate together for art style consistency. Each joins at different story points.
Male, older than Amaro. Broad, strong build.
Garrison sergeant — worn veteran look. Scars.
Heavy plate armor, practical not ornate.
Traversal: Double Jump (heavy but magically enhanced)
Female, young. Light, agile build. Athletic.
Former military deserter — practical but free-spirited.
Engineer — goggles, tool belt, stained work coat.
Lumina tech integrated into gear (glowing conduits).
Generate all 4 in one session for style consistency with Batch 1 (Amaro/Taighe). Each needs unique silhouette. Kael=massive, Sera=slim/fast, Varn=stocky/practical, Lyra=ethereal.
Each boss is unique — no recolors. Generate in story order. Complex rigs with breakable parts and phase changes.
Human fused with mining equipment. Industrial horror.
Phase 2: Switches to mining hammer after drill breaks.
Anims: DrillThrust, DrillSpin, HammerSlam, ChargeThrow, SummonSoldiers, DrillBreak, Stagger, Death
SPECIAL: Water VFX heavy — jets, floods, prison sphere
Anims: WaterLance(sweep), HydroBomb, WaterDash, WaterPrison, BarrierUp/Break, Stagger, Death
Ice slam, frost breath, spike eruption
P1: Recognizably human military officer (sword + tactics).
P2: Corruption transforms — larger, monstrous, corruption blade.
SPECIAL: Needs 2 models (human form + corrupted form) or morph
Emotional fight — was an ally. Uniform visible under corruption.
P2: Splits into 3 smaller crystal entities.
Reactor Core Descent · 2000 HP · 4 PHASES · End of Game
Manifestation of destabilized Lumina. Not a creature — a force of nature given form.
P1: Elemental rotation (shifts appearance). P2: Gravity warps. P3: Splits Light/Dark. P4: All at once.
SPECIAL: Most complex model — elemental VFX layers, Light half + Dark half meshes, aura effects
Size: ~4x player. Otherworldly, abstract geometry + organic corruption. Crown jewel of art pipeline.
New enemy faction — corruption aesthetic (purple, violet, crystalline). Completely distinct from military.
Military uniform torn/warped, purple veins, glowing eyes
HP: 65 · Weak: Light · Scream vulnerability window
BASE: Garrison Soldier mesh + corruption overlay shader
Could potentially reuse Garrison Soldier with corruption material
Translucent spirit, wispy form, claw hands
SPECIAL: Needs transparency shader + phase animation
Crystalline beast, 4 legs, angular, sharp edges
HP: 55 · Weak: Earth · Reflects magic during charge
Anims: Prowl, Crouch, Charge, Slide, Swipe, Reflect
SIMPLE RIG: No locomotion — rotate + lob only
Large corrupted animal/machine, crystal growths on shoulders
HP: 150 · Weak: Light · Crystal shoulders (40 HP each)
COMPLEX: Breakable parts = separate sub-meshes that shatter
Anims: Charge, Slam, Roar(enrage), CrystalBreak(L/R), Stagger
Small spectral entity, wispy, gentle look (deceptive)
REUSE: Could share Wraith rig with smaller scale + recolor
Security Automaton with corruption growths, sparking
HP: 90 · Weak: Ice · Overloads every 20s → 3s stun
BASE: Security Automaton mesh + corruption overlay
Anims: Same as Automaton + Overload(spark), Stun(collapse)
Tank AOE · Darkness field · Plants anchors
Massive dark construct, angular void geometry, oppressive
HP: 130 · Weak: Light · IMMUNE: Dark (heals from it)
COMPLEX: Darkness field shader + Void Anchor spawnable
Anims: HeavySwing, FieldPulse, PlantAnchor, Stagger, Death

Corrupted faction uses purple/violet palette with crystal growths and wispy effects. 2 can reuse base meshes (Corrupted Soldier, Corrupted Automaton). 3 need new rigs (Stalker=quadruped, Beast=large quadruped, Wraith=spectral).
Lowest priority for unique models — can use generic templates early. Group by town for visual consistency.
Pastoral village · Warm tones · Simple clothing
F, elderly, village leader, robes, wise presence
F, young, herb-stained hands, green shawl
F, trader outfit, pack mule/cart aesthetic
M, relay worker, tools, Lumina-stained gloves
Create 3-4 villager base meshes (M/F young, M/F old). Swap hair,
clothing, accessories. Only unique: Elder Maren, Captain Dael.
Industrial port city · Military dress · Iron/bronze tones
M, military commander, decorated uniform, authority
F, muscular, forge apron, heat-resistant gear
M, weathered, naval coat, harbor clipboard
M, intelligence officer, sharp uniform, observant
F, goggles, prototype tools, inventive energy
Military faction base meshes. Thane is key (returns in S3).
Kelda and Petra should look distinct from soldiers.
Frozen harbor · Cold weather gear · Blue/white tones
F, naval admiral, heavy cold-weather coat, stern
F, scientist, thick glasses, research coat, curious
F, healer robes, warm face, medical supplies
Cold-weather variants of base meshes. Heavy coats, boots, fur.
Yrel returns in S3 — needs consistent look.
F, young, light recon gear, Elder Maren's relative
(Same as Ironhaven Innkeeper — now refugee leader)
Reuse existing NPC models with damage/wear. Thane returns
(same model, battle damage). Yrel returns (same + tired).
Only truly new: Scout Maren, Archivist Seren (2 models).
Cmdr Thane, Healer Yrel, Innkeeper Aldric — reuse models
with wear/tear shader variant. Same rig, damaged textures.
✓ Corrupted Soldier = Garrison Soldier + corruption shader/overlay
✓ Corrupted Automaton = Security Automaton + corruption growths
✓ 4 Elite enemies = base meshes with recolor + minor additions (heavier armor, frost effects)

svg.text: RAGNORAK · CHARACTER GENERATION GUIDE · 55 MODELS · 7 BATCHES · GENERATE IN ORDER FOR MAXIMUM CONSISTENCY
